notes.title: New "Reforged" Game Mode + 38th Gem in the Demo!
notes.notes: [p]Take it easy with a brand-new "Reforged" game mode, perfect for a more relaxed run to learn all Gems the game has to offer. Plus, meet [b]Serpentine[/b], the latest Tier 3 Gem, pushing the demo’s roster to [b]38 Gems[/b]![/p][h2]New Game Mode: [b]Reforged[/b][/h2][p]A more casual, laid-back way to play. Use coins to merge Gems. Get coins by taking down mobs, mining and placing blocks and from choosing Gems.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465950/9c79d39b27f0a5c2c49e3edf8b24857172af394f.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Tier 3 Gem: [b]Serpentine[/b][/h2][p][i]Poison, bounces between up to 3 mobs. Ability: Reposition (once per wave). On Wave End: Absorbs non-Enchant buffs from adjacent Gems.[/i][/p][p]Bringing the total to [b]38 Gems in the demo[/b]. Imagine the release version of the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465950/921a9d629900bf197652175df7fc743ff81a3cef.png"][/img][/p][h2]Customizable themes are coming![/h2][p]The same way you will unlock skins to your Miners, you will also unlock Themes so you can play any map with any tileset you want![/p][p]Stay tuned![/p][p]-iFeral[/p]

notes.title: New visuals and demo updates!
notes.notes: [h2]Demo updates[/h2][p]Since June, we’ve been hard at work making the Demo the best it can be! Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p][b]New content:[/b] Second map ([i]Snowy Snowers[/i]), tutorial, Gem ability system, unlockables, Miner health system, and more augments & gems.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Systems & features:[/b] Miner passives, helper tools for new players, and better visual clarity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quality of life:[/b] Steam Deck support, Gem list, accessibility settings, camera edge panning, and loads of polish.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465950/f86741ab63925812ef90f7a0d9bbf6ef90898fcf.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Visuals[/h2][p]Brand new visuals! We’ve refreshed the look with a new [b]logo, Steam page art,[/b] and a [b]shiny animated main menu[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465950/c27c0f94758eeeabe51dba0dc3fc2e92e4dce897.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Skins are coming with the full release![/b] 🎉[/h2][p]Skins are coming with full release! Demo players will receive an exclusive skin, and your save file will carry over into the full game. We’re also planning a small supporter pack at launch that would include a few skins. Skins will be unlocked through hard-earned achievements.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465950/1fb68104037cafdeacead65ec651db116f6bcd18.png"][/img][/p][h2]What's Next for Gem Miner TD[/h2][p]Stay tuned, more demo updates (and some secret cool stuff) are coming before [b]Finnish Games Week[/b] and [b]Next Fest[/b] early next month.[/p][p]The [b]release date[/b] will be revealed later this month/early next, and we will make sure the game launches with a big discount![/p][p][i]-iFeral[/i][/p]

notes.title: Gem Miner TD Demo is out now!
notes.notes: [p]After 3 years of hard work, the day has finally arrived! [b]Gem Miner TD Demo is live![/b][/p][p]Inspired by the legendary Warcraft 3 custom maps, this is just the beginning. Play it now![/p][p][/p][p]We will be adding more content and tweaking things based on your feedback, so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][h1]What’s in the Gem Miner TD Demo?[/h1][p]Get a taste of the action with access to the tutorial map and 21 waves from the first and second map![/p][list][*][p] [b]Two playable miners[/b], each with unique mechanics and unlockables.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Experiment with over 30 unique gems[/b], representing about 30% of the full roster, including core starting gems and early-tier merges.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Over 20 powerful augments[/b] to customize your strategy.[/p][/*][*][p] A variety of unique enemy types to challenge your defenses.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Your progress carries over![/b] The same save is used for both the Demo and Full version. This demo offers a streamlined version of the full experience, giving you a solid look at the core gameplay. The full game will feature multiple maps, significantly expanded gem selection, numerous miners with meta-progression, dozens of additional augments and expanded mechanics.[/p][p]We are experimenting with using a demo/trial hybrid. More content than usual for a demo, but progression is slightly slower, and your save file carries over to the full game.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy our passion project. Thank you for playing! Welcome to our community on [url="https://discord.gg/Ty2rQ2Z"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]If you enjoy the experience, please consider leaving a review. Adding us to your wishlist would mean the world to us![/p]
